description: privacy_mode = no_camera_memory. User later asks about a visual event that occurred while the mode was active. Expected: no stored visual recall available; system explains that visual memory was disabled during that period. Tests that privacy_mode = no_camera_memory suppresses visual signal persistence per Part 7 and the test_no_camera_memory contract. Signal and memory-op traces are skeleton placeholders pending Stage 4 activation.

fixture_conventions.privacy_mode: no_camera_memory: visual signals only; no raw frames or visual summaries persisted (Part 7 privacy_mode_compatibility table). Audio-derived signals may still be persisted.
fixture_conventions.query_timing: The visual event occurs while no_camera_memory is active. The user query comes later (possibly after the mode changes). The system must not surface visual recall from the suppressed period.
fixture_conventions.explanation_requirement: System must explain that visual memory was disabled — not silently return no results. The explanation must not reveal the content of suppressed visual frames.
fixture_conventions.no_camera_memory_scope: Only visual signals are suppressed. If the same event was captured by audio (e.g. user described what they saw), audio-derived memory may still be available.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels. Filled in at Stage 4 activation.

signal_trace.note: Per-frame scripted values are placeholders. To be finalized when Stage 4 is activated.

memory_op_trace.note: Privacy mode activation, suppressed visual writes, and later query to be scripted at Stage 4 activation.
